mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1300K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 3.5%, indicating a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, leading to higher inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising retail sales (RSAFS) and increasing housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of high inflation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window during high-inflation periods, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200K over 2 months signals a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods with low unemployment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window during specified regimes, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
